boundary: Descriptive statistics over source segmentation labels, voxel counts, affine-scaled raster occupancy candidates, and independently framed spatial candidates. Source label identities are not cross-suite ontology mappings; cohort coordinates are not pooled; no physical tissue volume, mass, mechanics, calibration, or clinical claim is made.

cohort.distribution_quantile_method: linear interpolation at (n - 1) * probability; observed scans only

source.coordinate_convention: NIfTI RAS+ in millimetres; source scans retain independent voxel-to-world affines
source.segmentation_generation: MOOSE automatic segmentation at the 90-minute timepoint, as described by TCIA
